title: RayX CLI: machine setup, doctor, WSL, self update and the app pipeline for any RayX app

New group `tests/setup_engine.rs`: `--check` status and exit codes, execute runs only missing steps, a second run executes nothing, `--yes` reaches installer arguments, `--all` selects the sets applicable to each host fixture, root steps are batched.

New group `tests/setup_linux.rs`: the Ubuntu/Debian base plan (one batched apt install with the SETUP-2 package list, rustup, project toolchain, PATH), the same plan inside WSL, and the unsupported-distribution error.

New group `tests/setup_windows.rs`: x64 and ARM64 plans (Build Tools components incl. the ARM64 component, fxc directory choice from a fake Windows Kits tree, LLVM, VC++ redistributables per architecture, native rustup host) and the missing-winget error.

New group `tests/setup_macos.rs`: Command Line Tools through `softwareupdate` with the on-demand marker, the `xcode-select --install` fallback, Homebrew installation when missing, rustup and toolchain steps.

New group `tests/setup_web.rs`: pinned nightly with `rust-src` and the wasm32 target, stable wasm32 target, `wasm-bindgen-cli` at the locked version and its replacement when another version is installed, Clang/LLVM per OS.

New group `tests/setup_test_tools.rs`: Node and pnpm per OS, Linux xvfb/xdotool/Playwright system libraries, the project Playwright steps from the default and the metadata location, and the WSL PATH-order finding.

New group `tests/setup_android.rs`: JDK 21 and `JAVA_HOME` per OS, Android Studio per host (skipped under WSL), SDK discovery and the command-line-tools download, `sdkmanager` packages from pins (existing NDK honoured), emulator and host-arch system image, default AVD creation, acceleration (kvm group, Windows Hypervisor Platform), cargo-ndk and Rust targets, license handling with and without `--yes`.

New group `tests/setup_ios.rs`: Xcode through `xcodes` with a pinned and an unpinned version, the `mas` path, `xcode-select --switch`, license handling with and without `--yes`, `-runFirstLaunch`, Simulator runtime download when missing, XcodeGen and iOS targets; not applicable on other hosts.

New group `tests/setup_gpu.rs`: plans for fixture adapter lists — NVIDIA, AMD and Intel on Windows (winget driver packages), Adreno on Windows ARM64 (Windows Update path), Basic Render Driver only, Ubuntu NVIDIA (`ubuntu-drivers`) and Mesa, WSL (host-owned), macOS (report only).

New group `tests/doctor.rs`: text and JSON reports from fixture hosts with present, missing and wrong-version requirements; GPU adapters and `hardwareAdapter`; `interactiveDesktop` per OS; WSL findings; pins with sources; exit code 0.
`rayx doctor --json` on this machine inspects the real host and exits 0. The JSON carries `requirementCount`.
After provisioning, every set the checks need is complete on this machine.
This machine has a usable hardware adapter and an interactive desktop for the headed WebGPU spec.
cargo-dist is installed at the pinned version.
The xtask app-pipeline tests moved into `src/app/` (about 100), including the ones rewritten against fixture apps; selected with the `app::` filter on the library target.

New group `tests/app_project.rs`: fixture workspaces outside the RayX layout; app path relative to the current directory; artifacts under the workspace root including desktop pack; generated entry manifests copying path, git and registry `rayx` sources; root `[patch]` copying; `gpux-fonts` lookup; pinned nightly and wasm-bindgen with the version-mismatch error; ARM64 desktop triple.

New group `tests/app_prereqs.rs`: per target, the sets probed before building; unprivileged items installed automatically with a notice; privileged items prompting in an interactive terminal and stopping with the `rayx setup --<set>` command otherwise; `--no-install`.

New group `tests/app_playwright_template.rs`: renders the template with a Playwright pin and checks its files and flags; then runs `rayx app <fixture> test wasm` on a fixture app without a Playwright package, which creates the package and passes its smoke spec. New group `tests/app_wasm_fixture.rs`: builds the public-crates threaded fixture with `rayx app <fixture> build wasm`, verifies shared memory, serves it and asserts the COOP/COEP headers over HTTP. Needs the pinned nightly and wasm-bindgen (VAL-1).
New group `tests/fmt_command.rs`: per-member formatting and failure listing on a two-member fixture workspace, `--check` in any position.
Real RayX proof: Lab's threaded WASM build through `rayx` from the RayX checkout.
Real RayX proof: the Test Suite's diagnostic WASM build through `rayx`.
Real RayX proof: Lab's native host build through `rayx`.

gpux's Gradle-free Android host builds on JDK 21.

New group `tests/wsl_plan.rs`: WSL version gate, distribution install, missing-user stop, binary handoff (release asset and `RAYX_WSL_BINARY`), the inner setup command with the same flags, non-Windows refusal, `--clone` of the current checkout only (`/mnt/<drive>` translation, branch, fetch instead of re-clone), and a fixture whose manifest has `path` dependencies outside the workspace proving none of them is cloned.

New group `tests/wsl_disk.rs`: `status` from a fake `Lxss` registry, `wsl` output and sizes; the `compact` step plan — build-output listing and confirmed deletion, `fstrim`, the confirmed shutdown, `Optimize-VHD` versus the generated `diskpart` script in one admin child, before/after report, `--yes`, no sparse-disk command, the inside-WSL message.
`dist plan` accepts the configuration and lists the six targets and both installers.
New group `tests/self_update.rs`: version comparison, `--check` output, install-source detection with and without a dist receipt, and the instruction for non-installer builds.
The slim RayX xtask compiles with all targets.
The remaining chore tests (code-themes, component-index, theme) pass.

sprints.title: Repository, CLI surface and host layer

tasks.title: Package scaffold
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Create the `rayx-cli` package at the repository root: `Cargo.toml` (edition 2024, Apache-2.0, repository `https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.CLI`, lib `rayx_cli`, bin `rayx`), `src/lib.rs` with `pub fn run() -> ExitCode`, a thin `src/main.rs`, `rust-toolchain.toml` (1.95.0 with clippy and rustfmt), `LICENSE-APACHE`, a README skeleton, and extend `.gitignore`. Write `tests/package_layout.rs`.

tasks.title: Top-level commands
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/cli.rs` with clap derive: `setup` (set flags including `--gpu`, `--check`, `--yes`, `--all`, `--wsl`, `--clone`), `doctor [--json]`, `wsl status|compact`, `self update [--check]`, `fmt`, and `app` capturing raw trailing arguments. Commands not yet implemented return a clear "not implemented in this build" error until their sprint lands. Write `tests/cli_surface.rs` (drive the binary with `assert_cmd`).

tasks.title: Host facts
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/host/mod.rs`: `HostFacts`, the `Probe` trait, the real probe (`IsWow64Process2` via `windows-sys`, `sysctl.proc_translated` via `libc`, `/etc/os-release`, `/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease`, `WSL_DISTRO_NAME`) and fixture probes. Write `tests/host_facts.rs`.

tasks.title: Command runner
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/host/runner.rs`: `CommandSpec`, privilege levels, `Execute`/`Print`/`Record` modes, root detection on Unix (`geteuid`), `sudo` prefixing, per-command elevation on Windows (`ShellExecuteExW` `runas` child with output captured through a temporary file, declined prompt handled), inherited stdio for interactive specs. Write `tests/command_runner.rs`.

tasks.title: User PATH editing
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/host/path_env.rs`: `PathStore` with the registry implementation (`REG_EXPAND_SZ`, `WM_SETTINGCHANGE`) and an in-memory one; Unix profile block editing for bash, zsh and sh login profiles. Write `tests/path_env.rs`.

tasks.title: CI workflow and public repository
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, test on windows-latest, macos-latest, ubuntu-24.04; Rust cache). Create the public GitHub repository `rayx-ui/RayX.CLI` (`gh repo create rayx-ui/RayX.CLI --public --source . --remote origin`), push `main`, and confirm the first CI run is green. The owner approved creating it public on 2026-10-07.

sprints.title: One nightly and JDK pin across RayX and Gpux; toolchain-update skill reference

tasks.title: Pin nightly-2026-06-23 everywhere
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: RayX: add `[workspace.metadata.rayx] web-toolchain = "nightly-2026-06-23"` to the root `Cargo.toml`; make xtask's WASM build use that pin until sprint 7 removes it; install that toolchain (with `rust-src` and the wasm32 target) in `pr-test.yml`; fix `README.md` and the RayX skill's `diagnostics.md`. Gpux: change gpux-testkit's default toolchain to `nightly-2026-06-23` (keep `GPUX_WEB_TOOLCHAIN` as the override) and its test, and the docs and skill references PINX-1 lists. Gpux's active epic `gpux-cross-platform-test-lanes` also edits `tooling/testkit`: make the change on top of its current branch state and keep the commit separate. Paired commits in RayX and Gpux.

tasks.title: Pin JDK 21 everywhere
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: RayX: set Java 21 in the Gradle builds of `apps/lab`, `apps/test_suite` and `apps/examples_mobile` (`sourceCompatibility`/`targetCompatibility`, and the Kotlin JVM target where set); confirm the Android Gradle Plugin version supports it. Gpux: `java-version: 21` in `lane-e.yml`, the JDK in gpux-testkit's Android prerequisite message, and any doc naming JDK 17. The Android build proof runs in sprint 5 once the machine is provisioned.

tasks.title: RayX skill reference for toolchain updates
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `.claude/skills/rayx/references/wasm-toolchain-update.md` per PINX-3 and link it from the RayX skill's `SKILL.md`; add the one-line pointer in the gpux skill's `multithreaded-wasm-apps.md`.

tasks.title: Project discovery and pins
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/project/mod.rs` (`Project::discover`) and `src/project/pins.rs` (precedence, gpux-checkout profile, defaults table with `nightly-2026-06-23`, JDK 21 and Playwright 1.59.1, pin sources). Add fixture workspaces under `tests/fixtures/` (with and without metadata/lockfile, a gpux-checkout fixture with a `gpux-testkit` member). Write `tests/project_pins.rs`.

tasks.title: Setup planning and execution
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/setup/mod.rs`: requirement sets (base, web, test, android, ios, gpu), `Step`, `plan`, `execute` (probe, skip, run, re-probe), root-step batching, `--check`/`--yes`/`--all` handling and exit codes, wired to `rayx setup`. Write `tests/setup_engine.rs`.

tasks.title: Ubuntu/Debian base set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/setup/linux.rs` and `src/setup/rust.rs`: the SETUP-2 apt list (from LINUX-WSL.md section 2 and gpux CI), rustup non-interactive install, project toolchain, cargo bin on PATH, unsupported-distribution error. Write `tests/setup_linux.rs`.

tasks.title: Windows x64 and ARM64 base set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/setup/windows.rs`: winget steps for Build Tools (VCTools workload, Windows SDK, ARM64 component on ARM64), fxc discovery under `Windows Kits\10\bin` (newest version, host-arch directory, fallback as the PowerShell script does), LLVM with PATH, VC++ redistributables per architecture, native rustup host via `rustup-init.exe` for the native triple. Write `tests/setup_windows.rs`.

tasks.title: macOS base set
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/setup/macos.rs`: Command Line Tools through `softwareupdate` with the on-demand marker and the `xcode-select --install` fallback, Homebrew installation, rustup and toolchain. Write `tests/setup_macos.rs`.

tasks.title: Android workstation set (replaces setup-android)
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/setup/android.rs` per SETUP-7: port the discovery and install steps of RayX xtask's `setup_android_machine`, and add JDK 21 with `JAVA_HOME`, Android Studio, command-line tools, build-tools pin, emulator, system image, default AVD, acceleration and Rust targets. Verify winget/cask/snap package names while implementing. Write `tests/setup_android.rs`.

tasks.title: Xcode and iOS set

tasks.title: GPU driver set

Write `tests/setup_gpu.rs`.

tasks.title: Doctor
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/doctor.rs`: evaluate every applicable set in probe-only mode, GPU adapters and `hardwareAdapter`, `interactiveDesktop`, WSL findings, pins with sources, text and `--json` output with `requirementCount`, exit 0. Write `tests/doctor.rs`.

sprints.title: App pipeline for any RayX app, proven on a provisioned machine

tasks.title: Provision this machine for the checks
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Build `rayx` from this repository and run `rayx setup --web --test --android --gpu` on this machine (the owner answers UAC and license prompts); install cargo-dist 0.32.0 (`cargo install cargo-dist --locked --version 0.32.0`, or a newer release then amended into the checks and the release task). Fix any setup defect found here in the CLI and rerun. Confirm the desktop session and hardware adapter through `rayx doctor --json`.

tasks.title: Move the app modules
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Copy RayX xtask's `app`, `args`, `assets`, `package_assets`, `command` (app part), `desktop`, `wasm`, `android`, `ios`, `node_tools`, `process` and `fs_util` into `src/app/`, wire `rayx app` to the moved parser, and port their tests. Rewrite the 24 tests that read RayX's `apps/lab`, `apps/examples_mobile` or `crates/` against fixture apps under `tests/fixtures/`, and send staging output to temporary directories. Commit the copy before behavior changes, naming the source RayX commit.

tasks.title: Remove the RayX-layout couplings
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Replace `repo_root()` with `ProjectContext`; resolve the app path against the current directory; join `target`/`artifacts`/`artifacts-temp` to the workspace root everywhere (fixes desktop `pack`); copy the app's resolved `rayx`/`rayx_devkit` dependency into generated entry manifests; read `[patch]` from the selected root manifest; find `gpux-fonts` through `cargo metadata`; use pinned nightly and locked wasm-bindgen with the version check; host-native desktop triples; drop the release re-exec. Write `tests/app_project.rs`.

tasks.title: Prerequisites before every app command
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Ask `setup` for the target's sets in probe mode before building; install unprivileged items automatically, prompt or stop for privileged ones, honour `--no-install`. Write `tests/app_prereqs.rs`.

tasks.title: Test commands for any RayX app
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement APP-6: Playwright package resolution and template creation, spec and project selection, `RAYX_APP_URL` and `RAYX_WEBGPU_REQUIRED`, removal of every app-name special case, native `test host|windows|linux|macos` through `cargo test` of the app package, and the unsupported-target message. Write `tests/app_test_command.rs`.

tasks.title: Embedded Playwright package template
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `src/app/templates/playwright/` (package.json, playwright.config.ts with the per-OS WebGPU flag table, the canvas/backend fixture, a smoke spec, .gitignore) per APP-8, rendered with the Playwright pin and written once. Add a fixture app without a Playwright package and write `tests/app_playwright_template.rs`.

tasks.title: Public threaded-WASM fixture
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `tests/fixtures/threaded_wasm_app/` (wasm-bindgen with atomics, no RayX/gpux dependency, its own `[workspace]`) and `tests/app_wasm_fixture.rs` building, verifying and serving it with an HTTP header assertion.

tasks.title: rayx fmt
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Move xtask's `fmt` to `src/fmt.rs` on the discovered workspace with `--check` anywhere. Write `tests/fmt_command.rs` with a two-member fixture.

tasks.title: Prove on the real RayX checkout and gpux
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Run the APP-4 builds (WASM, host, Android on JDK 21) and the focused headed WebGPU Test Suite spec from the RayX checkout with `rayx` built from this repository, plus gpux-testkit's Android build on JDK 21. Compare the artifact layout with what xtask produced; fix differences in the CLI, not in RayX.

sprints.title: WSL setup, disk status and compaction; releases and self update

tasks.title: setup --wsl and --clone of the current checkout
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/setup/wsl.rs` per WSL-1 and WSL-2, with `RAYX_WSL_BINARY` for development builds. Write `tests/wsl_plan.rs`. Verify the end-to-end run manually on this Windows machine with a Linux build of `rayx` and record the outcome in the task handoff.

tasks.title: wsl status and wsl compact
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/wsl.rs` per WSL-3 and WSL-4 (registry view, sizes, build-output listing and confirmed deletion, `fstrim`, confirmed shutdown, `Optimize-VHD` or `diskpart` in one admin child, before/after report). Write `tests/wsl_disk.rs`. Run a real compaction on this machine with the owner's approval and record the before and after sizes in the task handoff.

tasks.title: cargo-dist releases
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `dist init` with cargo-dist 0.32.0 (the VAL-1 version), the six targets and shell/PowerShell installers, generated `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `dist plan` passing. Tagging the first release is the owner's call; it is verified manually when cut.

tasks.title: self update
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/update.rs` with `axoupdater`: update, `--check`, receipt detection and the non-installer message. Write `tests/self_update.rs`.

tasks.title: README and app-project contract
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: README: install one-liners, every command (including `wsl status`/`wsl compact` and the GPU, Xcode and Android Studio installs), the pins and their sources. `docs/app-project.md`: the `[package.metadata.rayx]` keys, `[workspace.metadata.rayx]` pins, `rayx.assets.toml`, the Playwright package template, and the app-owned `platform/android` and `platform/ios` files the pipeline expects, so `rayx new` can generate them later.

sprints.title: RayX switches to rayx and slims xtask

tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Remove the app pipeline, `setup-android`, `setup-wasm`, `fmt` and the release re-exec from RayX's `xtask/`, keep `code-themes`, `component-index` and `theme`, trim `xtask/Cargo.toml`. Paired commit with the CLI commit it relies on.

tasks.title: RayX callers use rayx
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Update RayX CI (installing the pinned `rayx` and calling `rayx setup --test` and `rayx app ...`), docs, READMEs, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, the RayX skill (including `wasm-toolchain-update.md`'s proof commands) and the two `tools-node` scripts per MIG-2.
